name: Hyūga (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Hyūga city emblem in white: a ring with a small notch at the top enclosing a ring.
history: Municipal flag of Hyūga, a city in Miyazaki Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 1 April 1966; the emblem dates from 1 April 1951.

features.role: Hyūga city emblem — a ring with a small notch at the top enclosing a ring
